title: Cross-City Alert Synchronicity
scenario: Find pairs of cities that triggered alerts within 1 hour of each other.
hint: Self-join on time difference within interval.
correctQuery: SELECT a1.city_name, a2.city_name FROM climate_alerts a1 JOIN climate_alerts a2 ON a1.city_name < a2.city_name WHERE ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a1.alert_time - a2.alert_time))) <= 3600;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE climate_alerts (city_name VARCHAR, alert_time TIMESTAMP);
